summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added to sparql/sparql.py beside Query; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request early exit builds the prologue via translatePrologue(q.prologue or [], base, initNs)); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_prepared_update.py added. Nothing was run, so the new tests and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. Nothing committed.
